name: elohim_warrior
description: an Elohim Warrior, a brown-haired bearded young man: a cream-white hood thrown back from his tousled hair, a cream-white robe with a pale-blue sash tied at the waist and hanging down the front, a wooden-bead rope belt, cream leg wraps and brown boots, a studded wooden club raised in his RIGHT hand (screen-left) and a round shield with a brown rim, brass studs and pale-blue and cream rings on his LEFT arm (screen-right)
hands: the studded club stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and the round shield on his left arm on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the studded club is lifted beside the head with its studded head pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the club hand behind the head and the studded club hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the club arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the club is level, its studded head pointing to the right
strike.4: contact: club arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the studded club smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, shield arm swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the club carries on down until its studded head nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, hair and hood trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the club comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (club arm thrown up and out to the left, shield flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the club dipping, shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, club arm flung up, shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the club lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the club's studded head resting on the ground at the lower-right, shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the club slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the club lies on the ground at the lower-right; the round shield lies flat beside him
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, club and shield on the ground beside him
